perplexity_poller.description: Fetches XLM macro context (RSI, Fib, volume, sentiment) and writes structured JSON

unified_scorer_modifier.name: perplexity_context
unified_scorer_modifier.logic: Confirms trade direction = +5, counter-trend when bias strong = -8, neutral = 0. Breakout proximity sub-gate: within 5% of range edge going counter = extra -6

performance_tracking.description: Logged after each trade cycle where perplexity_context was non-zero
